articles.summary: Kalshi taps The Weather Company's enterprise weather data to settle markets, while bringing real-time probability data to The Weather Channel app and weather.com.
articles.title: Kalshi and The Weather Company partner to bring trusted scientific weather data to the prediction market space

articles.summary: Kalshi announced a multi-year partnership with Nasdaq Market Surveillance to support real-time oversight of its prediction markets and perpetual futures.
articles.title: Kalshi Adopts Nasdaq Market Surveillance to Enhance Market Oversight

articles.summary: Kalshi is now the Official Prediction Market Partner of the US Open. The multi-year deal includes on-court signage, digital integration, and a real-time data-sharing agreement with the ITIA.
articles.title: Kalshi named first-ever prediction market partner of the US Open

articles.summary: Kalshi has announced exclusive, multi-year brand partnerships with the Braves, Red Sox, Dodgers, Padres, and Giants.
articles.title: Kalshi partners with iconic Major League Baseball brands
